{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Matches 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label and heavily modifies `src/index/*` files including `BaseIndex`.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "unblocks #10102",
      "rationale": "Decouples optional indexes from node internal types and stops holding `cs_main` during index initialization and notifications. This removes a shared-lock dependency in the index framework and directly enables out-of-process indexes for multiprocess bitcoin (#10102)."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `src/interfaces/chain.h`, `src/interfaces/handler.h`, and `src/interfaces/types.h` to allow running indexes out-of-process.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "unblocks #10102",
      "rationale": "Expands `interfaces::Chain` and `interfaces::Handler` to isolate indexes from node internals. This directly serves the multiprocess project by enabling separate-process index execution."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Deletes unused `BlockInfo` declarations from `src/kernel/chain.h` and `src/kernel/chain.cpp`.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.15,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Kernel changes are limited to removing unused `BlockInfo` definitions, which is minor internal cleanup without API expansion."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches `src/net_processing.cpp` for incidental call adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify peer-to-peer relay, protocol logic, or network transport."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Incidental changes in `src/rpc/blockchain.cpp` and `src/rest.cpp` following index interface refactoring.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Only mechanically updates RPC and REST call sites to adapt to index interface changes without modifying RPC behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes under `src/test/` and `test/functional/` strictly exercise index behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test modifications are domain-specific tests and helpers for the index changes, not general test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches `src/util/btcsignals.h` and `src/init.cpp` solely to wire moved synchronization logic.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental edits that follow from moving index chain sync logic out of `BaseIndex`."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Does not alter consensus, block connection, or chainstate validation rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Although it eliminates `cs_main` locking during index sync, it affects optional index architecture rather than validation logic or chainstate invariants."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
